headline: Fourthline and Veridas Complete Merger Valued Over €200 Million
summary: Fourthline and Veridas concluded a merger valued at over €200 million. The digital identity group operates in Brazil and projects revenue exceeding €50 million in 2026.
why: Consolidation in the digital identity and cybersecurity sectors highlights ongoing corporate M&A activity driven by demand for regulatory compliance tools.

impacts.name: Digital Identity
impacts.why: The merger combines two digital identity companies into a larger enterprise valued over €200 million.
